aboutIntro: I'm a product designer who likes figuring out messy problems and turning them into things that make sense.
aboutParagraphs: I'm a product designer who likes figuring out messy problems and turning them into things that make sense.
I've been designing digital products for 7+ years, working across fintech, healthcare, education, SaaS, and consumer products.

I started out with a software engineering background, which still influences how I design today. I naturally think about how things work behind the interface, how a system scales, and what will actually make it into production.

Most of my work sits somewhere between UX, UI, and product thinking. Sometimes that means restructuring a complicated workflow. Sometimes it's building a design system from scratch. Sometimes it's figuring out why a perfectly good-looking screen isn't actually working.
I've also spent a lot of time working with distributed teams, developers, stakeholders, and other designers. I enjoy that part of the work as much as the actual designing.
These days, I'm particularly interested in product teams where I can take ownership of a problem, work closely with engineering, and help turn something complicated into something simple.
aboutAiHeading: I use AI as leverage, not authority.
aboutAiIntro: AI helps me streamline the design flow by speeding up repetitive and exploratory work. I stay responsible for the product judgment, accessibility, and final decisions.

aboutAiSteps.name: Explore with more range
aboutAiSteps.description: Challenge assumptions, generate alternative flows, and surface questions before I commit to a direction.

aboutAiSteps.name: Synthesize with more clarity
aboutAiSteps.description: Organise research and requirements, compare patterns, and turn scattered inputs into a useful point of view.

aboutAiSteps.name: Ship with better context
aboutAiSteps.description: Refine interface copy, check edge cases, and prepare design rationale and handoff notes that teams can act on.

services.name: Product design
services.description: Turning complex requirements into clear flows, useful interactions, and interfaces that help people complete real tasks.

services.name: Design systems
services.description: Creating reusable patterns, components, and guidance that help product and engineering teams move consistently.

services.name: Product critique
services.description: Finding friction, challenging assumptions, and giving teams a practical path from a rough product to a stronger experience.

aboutAvailability: I'm currently open to remote Senior Product / UX Design opportunities.
aboutOutside: I'm usually exploring new technology, building little side projects, or finding ways to make everyday things work a little better.
I also enjoy cars, which has probably resulted in more spreadsheets, comparisons, and unnecessary research than I'd like to admit.
